episodes.187332: Very cold temperatures led to rapid ice formation on rivers.  Localized flooding due to ice jams occurred along portions of the Kankakee River.
episodes.187923: After a brief break from 1/16 into 1/17, another strong low moving southeast from the Gulf of Alaska brought a new episode of heavy rain to Coos County on 1/17 into 1/19, with flooding lingering into 1/20.

events.narrative: The Coquille River at Coquille rose above minor flood stage of 21.0 ft at 17/1830 PST, and above moderate flood stage of 23.0 ft at 18/1430 PST, crested at moderate flood stage at 23.37 ft at 18/2130 PST. The river dropped below minor flood stage at 20/1130 PST.
Flooding was reported of overbank areas along the Kankakee River in Aroma Park.
